newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen up on plans to cut budget.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen up on plans to cut budget.

text.p: Thai stocks are expected to rise slightly on Wednesday as local retail investors are anticipated to buy in response to plans by the government to cut its annual budget spending in 1997 and 1998, brokers said.
The SET index ended 29.88 points, or 3.78 percent, higher at 820.11 on moderate 5.06 billion baht turnover on Tuesday.
"Retail investors are to buy today as they think the government's decision to cut the budget spending is a positive news," said Dusanee Klewpatinontha of Nithipat Capital.
The decision to slash the budget in fiscal 1997 and 1998 was announced on Tuesday. -- Suthep Chawla (662) 652-0642
